name: Startup88

sources.title: Homepage — active startup pitch blog; new 'Pitch your Startup' posts dated Sep 21, 2026; submission links to Typeform
'Pitch Your Startup' Typeform — field list read from embedded form JSON, including $9.95 express-review payment question

conditions: Free submission joins the normal editorial queue (form notes 'we normally get 200+ pitches a month'); a $9.95 express option buys front-page-for-24hr + express review/publication + social media posting to their ~12,000 followers
requirements: Startup/product pitch suitable for the site's 'Pitch your Startup' category
Form requires a non-generic founder email ('Please do not provide generic email addresses')
'Not all businesses are suitable for Startup88.com & we reserve the right not to publish' — rejected paid submissions are refunded within 48hrs
preparation: Startup name, tag line, website URL
Founder name + a real (non-generic) founder email, Twitter handle (include the @)
Elevator pitch (~2 paragraphs), target market, monetization model ('How will you make money?')
Product image or website screenshot to upload
workflow: Open https://startup88.com/ and click 'Pitch Your Startup' → Typeform at startup88.typeform.com/to/CRjWqM
Complete all fields including founder verification and image upload
Choose the free queue or pay $9.95 for express review + 24hr front page + social posting
Published pitches appear as posts under /category/startups (e.g. /startups/2026/09/21/<slug>/)
watchFor: Batch's /category/star URL was truncated — real listing category is /category/startups
The Typeform is the only submission channel — no email pitch route is published
Free-queue wait is unstated and volume is high (200+/month); express is $9.95
This is editorial writeup format (author bylines like 'Sachin'), not a self-serve listing
Content protection script blocks right-click/copy on site
countsAsLive: A post titled with your startup appears under https://startup88.com/category/startups or homepage with its own /startups/<date>/<slug>/<id> permalink
unknowns: Whether published pitches link out with a followed URL
Whether 'Featured' category placement costs extra beyond the $9.95 express
